summary: International Bancshares Corporation filed an 8-K announcing a $0.73 per share cash dividend declared on July 31, 2026, with record date August 14 and payment August 28, 2026. This is a routine discretionary dividend reflecting financial strength, not a special situation such as a buyback or special return. The filing includes a press release and standard disclosures. What to watch: no transaction mechanics, premium, or advisors; simply a regular capital return to shareholders.
